description: Arithmetic between an INTEGER and a NUMERIC column widens to decimal instead of taking the left operand's type

columns.name: a
columns.note: price (int32) * msrp (decimal) widens to decimal, matching PostgreSQL's integer * numeric -> numeric

columns.name: b
columns.note: operand order reversed: still decimal, proving this isn't 'left operand wins'

name: arithmetic_widens_to_decimal
query_sql:
-- @name GetDiscountedPrice
-- @returns :many
SELECT price * msrp AS a, msrp * price AS b FROM order_items
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE order_items (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, price INTEGER NOT NULL, msrp NUMERIC NOT NULL)
